title: Chapter 735
paragraphs: Chapter 735
Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (7)
Thud-!
Pieces of the chain were falling to the ground.
The exposed Alphen looked startled as his eyes widened.
He had a much younger face than Jin had anticipated.
Jin instinctively realized that the energy of Rosa, who had been controlling Alphen, had been released.
"Nice to meet you, ancestor. I'm Jin Runcandel, the twelfth knight of Chiron Runcandel, the 59th master of Runcandel."
Jin kneeled on one knee and formally bowed.
Alphen glanced at the ongoing battle behind Jin, then at Jin, and finally seemed satisfied as he nodded his head.
[There are also shining individuals in the current generation. The situation is urgent, so let's first cut down the rebels!]
"I will do so."
Alphen's longsword, which had just been dyed with his fighting spirit, was now glowing bright white.
In line with his title as the 'Knight of Light', his aura indeed appeared to be stronger and brighter than that of ordinary warriors.
[Rebels, you don't deserve to wear the helmet of the Black Knight....]
Alphen charged toward the center of the battlefield, swinging his longsword.
The martial arts of the Black Knight's captain, who had been dueling with Bianca, faltered at his sword, and Jin seized the opportunity to strike at his head.
The helmet burst open, revealing the face of a monster stained black with chaos.
Senkado, the Black Knights here too.

They were once individuals who had dedicated themselves to their families and had enjoyed the honor of being laid to rest in the tomb, but now they were in the form of such rotten and fallen monsters.
The faces of Alphen and the Black Knight's captain were contrasted.
Just as the Black Knight's captain attempted to leap and escape the crisis, Jin and Bianca's swords once again restricted his movement.
And then, Alphen's thrust plunged into the face of the Black Knight's captain.
Bang-!
With a heavy sound like a cannon fire, the Black Knight's captain's head simply disappeared.
[Now, let go of the unnecessary burden.]
With the death of the Black Knight's captain, the remaining Black Knights lost their focus.
They were initially unable to gain the upper hand, even before Jin joined. And now with the addition of their comrades and Alphen, they had no more moves to make.
Escape was even impossible. There was no path for them to flee in this desolate space.
They were dyed in chaos, but they were still Black Knights, so they managed to hold out for a while in their own way.
But that was all. It was infinitely inadequate to confront warriors who would rank in the top echelons throughout the entire history of mankind.
Crack!
The prolonged battle ended when Hedo crushed the torso of the last remaining Black Knight.
"Now it would be nice if you explained what happened, Twelfth Knight. Why has the Knight of Chaos suddenly become an ally?"
"Do you think I conspired with the abominable?"
"Not necessarily, but it's a situation that can be misunderstood."
"I... didn't... misunderstand... it's good... if the number of allies increases. The abominable... is too... powerful."

"As you can see, my ancestor has just been released from the control of the abominable, Octavia Zipfel. As Bianca said, it's a good thing to increase the number of allies. There must be others like my ancestor. Isn't that right, ancestor?"
[Since I died at a young age, being called an ancestor feels strange. Just call me Sir Alphen, Twelfth Knight.]
"Understood."
"Alphen Runcandel? From the Holy National Defense War?"
Octavia asked, surprised.

[Yes. You, referred to as Octavia... must be the descendant of Hanel Zipfel, who fought in the Holy National Defense War with me. Hanel, he was indeed an odd head of the Zipfel family, but he was a man of some dignity. That's why I didn't doubt him like you do now, even when he spared a surrendered demon.]
"Sir Alphen, I was not doubting, but simply..."

[When I was bound by the control of the abominable, I understood the approximate situation through its inner self. Twelfth Knight, only you can defeat it and stop this situation. I, Alphen Runcandel, will devote myself to regaining our lineage following you from now on.]
Alphen cut off Octavia's words.
Jin felt his chest heat up once again.
There was definitely hope left in the Runcandel lineage. It wasn't just Jin who was struggling to hold on to hope.
"Thank you, Sir Alphen."
Now he had to call the allies above, inform them of the situation, and start moving again.
But Alphen brought up a story that the alliance hadn't anticipated at all.
[Once you descend in this atrocious castle, it is structured so that you can't ascend again, Twelfth Knight.]
"You said it's structured so that we can't ascend again?"
[Yes. Each floor of the castle is formed as a thoroughly separated subspace. To be exact, it should be called the inner world of the abominable.]
Inner world.
Not long ago, Jin had fought Rosa in his inner world.
And conversely, the castle of the abominable now was the inner world of Rosa, manifested in reality.
That was why the lower forces on the upper floors were suddenly exposed to mental attacks. The weaker they were, the harder it was to proceed through this inner world.
[Therefore, it is also impossible to signal the allies left on the upper floors.]
It would have been a normal subspace that Jin could cut with his spirit sword, but that didn't apply in the abominable's inner world.
"Then we'll have to wait here until our allies come."

[That too has a high chance of not going as planned. The magician of the Zipfel family... and that slow-talking demon must be a nun of Caligo. Anyway, it was fortunate that the magician, nun, and knight joined. The structure of the inner world is constantly changing.]
Above all, the inner world was like a maze, unlike what it seemed.
Even if you go back the way you came, the same space doesn't come out.
As Alphen said, the reason Hedo, Octavia, and Bianca were able to join was because the structure of the inner world had not changed until now.
"...If what Sir Alphen says is true, we're in trouble."
Hedo said.
"If we don't hear from our allies in ten minutes, we will move to the next floor."
Jin came to that conclusion.
There was no reason to wait long. If no allies join in that time, their paths are already crossed.
While waiting, Alphen provided the group with information about the abominable's forces.
[Twelfth Knight, to my knowledge, thirteen House Heads have been resurrected in the sacred tomb.]
The number included Alphen and Lionel. The group felt strange about the fact that the resurrected House Heads coincidentally equaled the number of pure-blooded second generation.

[The House Heads assigned to each floor are like gatekeepers. However, I'm not sure how many of them have not succumbed to the will of the abominable like me. I don't know exactly about the forces excluding the House Heads, but the Black Knights who just died are only a tiny part.]
Then the rough battle would be a face-off between the heroes of each faction of the temporary alliance, the resurrected House Heads, and the forces under the fleet and the Knights of Chaos.

[Mental attacks, aura, and factors that interfere with the creation of magic will also intensify as we go down. It won't be a big problem for people of our level, but it will be fatal for those who are less qualified.]
"I led all the fleets because I was considering an aerial battle with Ram... it may have been the wrong choice."
Originally, it might have been necessary to minimize the forces and fight the decisive battle, but as Jin fell into such a question, Alphen shook his head.

[During the Holy National Defense War, I also had the same concern as you. Unlike the representatives of the era, the elites below died like flies. But without them, we would have ultimately lost. The abominable will surely use everything it has, and it will want to reduce the power of the temporary alliance here as much as possible before that.]
Ten minutes have passed.
No allies had come down further underground. In the meantime, the party had made several attempts to check if it was really impossible to go back upstairs, but to no avail.
In the end, the final destination where Jin and the temporary alliance had to reach was the abyss of this inner world where the monstrous deity resided.
Hoping to join their allies safely there, they had no choice but to keep moving forward.
The journey started again.
After a while, the party encountered a cliff just as ridiculously deep and large as the one they had seen upstairs.
"Let's go down."
Jin, Alphen, Hedo, Bianca, Octavia. The five people began to descend the cliff simultaneously.
Meanwhile, the allies left upstairs were descending the same cliff where Jin had gone down, all aboard their warships.
However, what they met on the ground was not Jin and his party, but three resurrected sovereigns from the Spirit Tomb and countless chaotic troops.
In the center stood the Lion King, Lionel.
"Attack."
As Lionel dryly commanded, the army of Chaos rushed in like a tidal wave.
In the air, there were chaos dragons and black lines, and on the ground, there were monstrous creatures similar to giants and knights.
'There are no signs of the battles that Jin and those who went ahead had. I don't know why, but it seems we've been separated from Jin... Maybe the structure of the fortress is not consistent.'
Veradin made a quick decision without panicking.
"Begin the battle, Fire Dragon Kadun, Knights Dante and Bale take the enemy leaders. Orgal and Zephyrin focus on protecting the fleet."
Veradin also promptly issued orders and started the counter-attack.
The problem was that the power of the main guns of the fleet, including Kojek, was significantly reduced.
It was because the evil spirit's energy was blocking the creation of aura and magic.
Moreover, as the inner world deepened, the mental attacks became fiercer. Middle and lower-ranking forces in the fleet were screaming and falling down.
A warship isn't operated alone.
As more and more wizards lost consciousness, the operation of the fleet inevitably slowed down.
"Lonil, take command. I'm going down too."
"Yes, little sovereign."
"Kadun and Tuyan, recall all the dragons except Finia to the ship and inform them that the Devil's Stone has been opened."
Kojek was spreading ominous resonance from the power department.
As the Devil's Stone began to open, Veradin's body was rapidly aging.
Soon he became an old man with white hair like Kelliark Ziephal and extended his sovereign staff, 'Huroti'.
[It's not only you who can use unreasonably monstrous power.]
From Huroti, the extinction flame orb transformed by Kelliark was spreading.
